package br.com.caelum.cj05;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.PrintStream;

import javax.servlet.ServletException;
import javax.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

@SuppressWarnings("serial")
public class MinhaAplicacaoWebEmUmaServletNojenta extends HttpServlet {

	@Override
	protected void service(HttpServletRequest request,
			HttpServletResponse response) throws ServletException, IOException {

		String pagina = request.getParameter("pagina");
		if (pagina == null) {
			pagina = "inicial";
		}
		
		if (pagina.equals("inicial")) {
			PrintStream out = new PrintStream(response.getOutputStream());
			out.append("<!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC \"-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Transitional//EN\" \"http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml1/DTD/xhtml1-transitional.dtd\">");
			out.append("<html xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml\"  lang=\"pt-br\">");
			out.append("<head>");
			out.append("<title>Minha Aplicacao Web</title>");
			out.append("<link rel=\"stylesheet\" type=\"text/css\" href=\"estilo.css\" />");
			out.append("</head>");
			out.append("<body>");
			out.append("<h1>Minha Aplicacao Web</h1>");
			out.append("<ul>");
			out.append("<li><a href=\"?pagina=inicial\">Pagina Inicial</a></li>");
			out.append("<li><a href=\"?pagina=inversor\">Inversor</a></li>");
			out.append("<li><a href=\"?pagina=somadora\">Somadora</a></li>");
			out.append("</ul>");
			out.append("<h2>Pagina Inicial</h2>");
			out.append("<p>Bem-vindo ao nosso Site!</p>");
			out.append("</body>");
			out.append("</html>");
			out.close();
		} else if (pagina.equals("somadora")) {
			PrintStream out = new PrintStream(response.getOutputStream());
			out.append("<!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC \"-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Transitional//EN\" \"http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml1/DTD/xhtml1-transitional.dtd\">");
			out.append("<html xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml\"  lang=\"pt-br\">");
			out.append("<head>");
			out.append("<title>Minha Aplicacao Web</title>");
			out.append("<link rel=\"stylesheet\" type=\"text/css\" href=\"estilo.css\" />");
			out.append("</head>");
			out.append("<body>");
			out.append("<h1>Minha Aplicacao Web</h1>");
			out.append("<ul>");
			out.append("<li><a href=\"?pagina=inicial\">Pagina Inicial</a></li>");
			out.append("<li><a href=\"?pagina=inversor\">Inversor</a></li>");
			out.append("<li><a href=\"?pagina=somadora\">Somadora</a></li>");
			out.append("</ul>");
			out.append("<h2>Somando Numeros</h2>");
			out.append("<p>Vamos somar uns numeros.</p>");
			out.append("<form>");
			out.append("<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"pagina\" value=\"somadora\"/>");
			
			String numero1 = request.getParameter("numero1");
			String numero2 = request.getParameter("numero2");
			
			if (numero1 != null && numero2 != null) {
				int a = Integer.parseInt(numero1);
				int b = Integer.parseInt(numero2);
				out.append("<input type=\"text\" name=\"numero1\" value=\""+ numero1 +"\"/> + ");
				out.append("<input type=\"text\" name=\"numero2\" value=\""+ numero2 +"\"/> = ");
				out.append("<b>" + (a+b) + "</b>");
			} else {
				out.append("<input type=\"text\" name=\"numero1\"/> + ");
				out.append("<input type=\"text\" name=\"numero2\"/> = ");
				out.append("<b>?</b>");	
			}
			
			out.append("<br/><input type=\"submit\" value=\"Somar!\">");
			out.append("</form>");
			out.append("</body>");
			out.append("</html>");
			out.close();
		} else if (pagina.equals("inversor")) {
			PrintStream out = new PrintStream(response.getOutputStream());
			out.append("<!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC \"-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Transitional//EN\" \"http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml1/DTD/xhtml1-transitional.dtd\">");
			out.append("<html xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml\"  lang=\"pt-br\">");
			out.append("<head>");
			out.append("<title>Minha Aplicacao Web</title>");
			out.append("<link rel=\"stylesheet\" type=\"text/css\" href=\"estilo.css\" />");
			out.append("</head>");
			out.append("<body>");
			out.append("<h1>Minha Aplicacao Web</h1>");
			out.append("<ul>");
			out.append("<li><a href=\"?pagina=inicial\">Pagina Inicial</a></li>");
			out.append("<li><a href=\"?pagina=inversor\">Inversor</a></li>");
			out.append("<li><a href=\"?pagina=somadora\">Somadora</a></li>");
			out.append("</ul>");
			out.append("<h2>Invertendo</h2>");
			out.append("<form>");
			out.append("<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"pagina\" value=\"inversor\"/>");
			out.append("<input type=\"text\" name=\"nome\" size=120 />");
						
			String nome = request.getParameter("nome");
			if (nome != null) {
				out.append("<br />Invertido: ");
				char[] onome = nome.toCharArray();
				char[] inverso = new char[onome.length];
				for (int i = 0; i < onome.length; i++) {
					inverso[onome.length - i - 1] = onome[i];
				}
				out.append(new String(inverso));
			}
						
			out.append("<br/><input type=\"submit\" value=\"Inverter!\">");
			out.append("</form>");
			out.append("</body>");
			out.append("</html>");
			out.close();
		}
	}
}
